current_episode.title: Mike Eruzione: The Miracle on Ice & Team USA Winning Olympic Gold

guest.titre: Olympic Gold Medalist, Captain of 1980 U.S. Men's Hockey Team
guest.bio_context: Mike Eruzione was the captain of the 1980 U.S. Olympic men's hockey team that defeated the Soviet Union at Lake Placid, scoring the game-winning goal in that historic upset. He has spent the past 46 years traveling the country as a speaker and ambassador for American Olympic hockey. Recently, he spoke to both the 2026 U.S. men's and women's Olympic hockey teams in Milan before they won gold medals, continuing his role as a symbol of American athletic achievement and leadership.

context.real_quote: What we did is what we did. What you do is what you do. This is your opportunity to go out there and show the world where the best hockey player in the world has come from.
key_stats: 1980: Year of the Miracle on Ice at Lake Placid when the U.S. defeated the Soviet Union
46 years later: Time span between the 1980 Olympic gold and the 2026 Milan Olympic gold medals
2-1: Score of both the 2026 men's and women's U.S. Olympic hockey gold medal games against Canada, both in overtime
2026 Winter Olympics in Milan: Location of the recent U.S. men's and women's hockey gold medal victories
$1.6 million: Amount Eruzione received from selling nearly all his Olympic memorabilia
$350,000 to $400,000: Total amount raised by Winthrop Charities over the years
$150,000: Prize money won by Eruzione on Who Wants to Be a Millionaire, which he used to start his charity
